content: actions/setup-node latest v7.0.0 (2026-07-14, ESM migration); actions/checkout v7.0.1 (2026-07-20). cache:'npm' hashes root package-lock.json by default; cache-dependency-path only needed for non-root lockfiles. Windows runners: npm creates junctions for workspace links; git checkout may need core.longpaths for deep node_modules paths (not needed for install, only for checked-in deep paths).
